title: Each batch merge archives the lane sessions whose PRs all merged or closed
why: Coordinator, 10:11 CST Nov 8: 62 of the newest 100 sessions are idle lanes whose PRs all merged or closed, and none is archived. The roadmap build lists them (lanes-to-archive row, #1312), but no tool acts on the list.
note: Filed 10:14 CST Nov 8 from the coordinator. Fix: at each batch merge, the merge tool or runner 8 (session_013NEJL2vsmyKzJm8jUDt6za) reads the idle-lane list (skills/roadmap/build.py idle_lanes), pushes any unmerged branch to archive/, then archives each session. Related: idle-lane-steps-unknown (ready), lane-end-releases-steps (doing). A gap fix: may start a lane under owner item 410 a. 10:25 CST Nov 8: the coordinator starts its lane after its archive audit reports, so the brief carries the measured flaw.
